from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party identified in the legal document."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the individual, company, or organization")
    role: str | None = Field(description="The legal role in the proceedings, e.g., '上诉人' (Appellant), '被上诉人' (Appellee), '被告人' (Defendant), '申请人' (Applicant)")

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal judgment or ruling document."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Official case reference number (e.g., '(2022) 陕 0722 刑初 98 号')")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the case, e.g., 'Civil' (民事), 'Criminal' (刑事)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="Description of the dispute or charge, e.g., 'Neighbor dispute' (相邻关系纠纷), 'Forgery' (伪造金融票证)")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of identified parties and their roles")
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="The core ruling decision as stated in the document (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '准许撤回再审申请')")
    outcome_details: str | None = Field(description="Specific penalties, fines, sentences, or fee allocations mentioned in the ruling")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Schema capturing extracted information from one legal document."""
    cases: list[CaseRecord]
